I am a research assistant in the Explainable AI group at the [Fraunhofer Heinrich Hertz Institute](https://www.hhi.fraunhofer.de/) in Berlin, supervised by Moritz Weckbecker, and a Master's student in Computer Science at the [Hasso Plattner Institute](https://hpi.de/) in Potsdam.

I work on backdoor detection for LoRA adapters using weight-space learning, and on understanding the backdoor mechanism itself with feature attribution methods. More broadly, I am interested in AI safety and interpretability, and in fine-tuning phenomena such as emergent misalignment and unexpected generalization.

::: {.about-list}
